title: Pickleball + Hot Tub + Pool + Gym + Sauna + Mini Golf + Sleeps 24
description:
Welcome to Pickleball Paradise—a NeekSleeps property! This stunning North Scottsdale 5-acre retreat is located close enough to all the attractions Scottsdale has to offer. 

This mansion is equipped with three pickleball courts, a pool (heated to 85° for $200/day), BBQ grill, 2 bed/2 bath guest house, 4 car ports and 2 decks to enjoy the views, you'll have everything you need and more while staying in your home away from home.

Please read the Other Details to Note section for important info.

 The space 
This property offers a: 

- meticulously remodeled 6 bed/4.5 bath, 4,927 square foot south-facing home

AND

- bonus 1,250 square foot 2 bed/2 bath guest home (casita)

Plus, you’ll have access to our newly constructed triple pickleball court. We provide all the equipment you’ll need to get a sweat in. 

All on a sprawling 5-acre property with stunning desert views.

You truly wont believe it until you see it...

When you enter the home, off to the right you have a charming sunken living space with a decorative fireplace and views of the front yard, intimate and including a cozy lofted bench, yet still open and connected to the larger living area set back a bit further.

This second living area, with steps extending out into the backyard, is the perfect place to entertain, with multiple seating areas, skylights, beautiful furniture, another decorative fireplace and a pool table all tied together in a spacious open floor plan. 

*Note- the bar area (ice maker, taps, etc) is from the previous owners and is not operational.

The kitchen features a 16-foot-long Brazilian tourmaline island with bar stool seating and large walk-in pantry with tons of cabinet space and a second refrigerator.

The WESTERN wing of the main home has 5 bedrooms including:
Room 1: King Bed
Room 2: Double bunk room (4 queen beds)
Room 3: King Bed
Room 4: 2 King Beds
Room 5: King Bed

The spacious master bedroom has dual closets AND two bathrooms (because why not?) and includes a 2-seated bathtub and walk-in shower with multiple shower-heads. This fabulous suite walks out onto a large wrap-around porch with views of the rose garden, pool and beautiful Pinnacle Peak beyond. 

The EASTERN wing of the home has 1 bedroom (we consider it the guest suite) with:

- One king bed
- A private balcony facing south
- Full attached bathroom

The outdoor space is perfect for entertaining with a pool (heating available for an additional $200/day) and seating areas all nestled under string lights with views of the mountain in the distance.

The CASITA is just on the other side of the pool and boasts-

- Bedroom 7: King bed
- Bedroom 8: King bed
- Two full baths

There is also a full kitchen with breakfast nook and living area, making it the perfect autonomous accompaniment to the larger main home. 

You are only:

- 18 miles to downtown Scottsdale
- 26 miles to Phoenix Sky Harbor airport
- 30 miles to downtown Phoenix
- 3 miles to Grayhawk Golf Club
- 5 miles to Troon Country Club
- 1 mile to La Mirada Shopping Center (coffee, drug store, etc)
- 4 miles to Safeway (grocery store)

Other amenities include 

- a BBQ grill
- a 2-car garage
- multiple car ports
- two viewing decks with stunning 360-degree views from both the main residence and the guesthouse

Do your friends, family and yourself a favor and come enjoy this breathtaking property and all it has to offer!

 Other things to note 
PICKLEBALL COURTS-
We do not have outside lights for the Pickleball courts. Please keep this in mind before booking, as our setup doesn’t lend itself to nighttime play.

MASTER-
Mini splits in the master bedroom do not work. There are 2 ceiling fans in the master in the event the house's A/C does not cool the room to your liking.

HEATING ELEMENTS-
DO NOT use the fire pit. It is from the former owners and difficult to operate.
All fireplaces in the home are decorative. 
We DO have HEAT LAMPS outside for your enjoyment. To turn ON, there is a breaker box located behind the outdoor bathroom. That breaker box actually turns the outdoor heat lamps on/off. So feel free to turn those on! Please just make sure to flip the breaker off once you’re done :)

Bathroom breakdown-
It says 6.5 but what that really means is 5 full bathrooms (3 in main home; 2 in casita) and 3 half bathrooms (2 in main home and one outside). Airbnb adds it all together (5 + 1/2 + 1/2 + 1/2 = 6.5) which is a bit silly so we just like to clarify :)

NOTE- A pool waiver MUST be signed by all guests prior to the start of the booking in order for guests to use the swimming pool at the property. Please reach out with any questions :)

-The home can sleep up to 20 guests. Guests 17-20 are charged $50/guest per night.

POOL HEATING- Pool heating is available for an additional $200/day. Please let us know AT LEAST 24 hours prior to your arrival whether or not you'd like this turned on, so that we can adjust the settings accordingly. If selected, we will set the pool to 85 degrees, which doesn't make the pool *hot* but does make it swimmable. (Without heating, temperatures can drop to low 50s in the winter.)

ROOF ACCESS- We do NOT allow guests to use either roof as a walk deck. This is for owner use only. Guest misuse/trespassing will result in removal from the property. Thank you for your cooperation, we promise the views from the backyard are just as stunning.

BAR- the bar area (ice maker, taps, lighting, etc) is from the previous owners and is not operational.
